description: This Java class 'AdHocQueryDataValidator' validates and processes JSON input parameters for ad-hoc loan query searches within the Fineract platform. It checks for required fields, validates parameter values, and constructs search condition objects.

classes.name: AdHocQueryDataValidator
classes.description: Validator class for ad-hoc query parameters related to loan searches, ensuring correct data format and value constraints.

methods.name: validateAdHocQueryParameters
methods.description: Validates the JSON string containing search parameters, checking for required fields, value correctness, and logical consistency.

methods.name: retrieveSearchConditions
methods.description: Parses validated JSON to extract and assemble search condition objects for loan queries.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws validation exception if any validation errors are accumulated.

methods.name: extractLongValuesList
methods.description: Converts a list of string IDs to a list of Long IDs.
